easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher.
Geralf's Mindcrusher dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Geralf's Mindcrusher, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.
